name: canvas-mcp
tagline_zh: 作业截止前还在翻Canvas？80+工具直连你的课程、成绩和待办，5个技能让AI替你盯紧每一条DDL。
tagline_en: Stop digging through Canvas. 80+ tools and 5 skills let AI watch your deadlines, grades, and courses—across 40+.
desc_en: Canvas LMS MCP server — 80+ tools and 5 agent skills for students & educators. Works with Claude, Cursor, Codex, and 40+ agents.
why_zh: 同类工具只读数据，它却把80+操作打包成5个技能，让AI能主动提醒、批改、甚至代填作业。
why_en: Unlike read-only scrapers, it packs 80+ actions into 5 agent skills—so AI can nudge, grade, and even submit for you.
